panels.description: Estimated from Prometheus histogram buckets. Lavik exports SLO-focused boundaries at 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6, and 8 ms.
panels.title: Command P99.9 Latency

panels.description: Estimated from Prometheus histogram buckets; precision is limited by bucket width and sample volume.
panels.title: Command P99.99 Latency

panels.description: P99.9 and P99.99 are estimates interpolated from Prometheus histogram buckets. Lavik exports dense boundaries around the 3 ms SLO and progressively wider buckets at higher latency; use longer windows for low-volume traffic.
panels.title: Command Latency Percentiles

panels.description: Completed storage reads, writes, and fdatasync barriers per second. Each series is aggregated across workers for the selected instance.
panels.title: Storage IOPS

panels.description: Completed storage read/write bytes per second. fdatasync is the logical write volume newly covered by successful durability barriers, not a device-reported physical transfer count.
panels.title: Storage Throughput

panels.description: Correlates per-instance command P99.9 latency with running, queued, paused, and configured defrag work.
panels.title: Defrag Impact on P99.9 Latency

panels.description: Worker-local retained bytes plus pending allocation and full-sync reservations as a percentage of that worker's fixed retained-memory share.
panels.title: Worker Retained Admission Utilization
Meta Data Observation Time
panels.description: Time spent collecting data state before sending a heartbeat, including cross-shard waits. Completed steps only; histogram quantiles are estimates. This is not the heartbeat interval or scheduler jitter, and has no automatic 1 ms warning threshold.

panels.title: Meta Lease Installation Time
panels.description: Time spent installing authority after receiving a lease, including cross-shard waits. Completed steps only; histogram quantiles are estimates. This is not the heartbeat interval or scheduler jitter, and has no automatic 1 ms warning threshold.

panels.title: Meta Connection State
panels.description: 1 means the control session is connected; 0 means disconnected. Missing data indicates unavailable scraping and must not be interpreted as zero.

panels.title: Meta Lease Decision Rate
panels.description: Lease grants and denials received by each Data node, separated by decision.

panels.title: Meta Exceptions (5 min)
panels.description: Local lease expirations, reconnect attempts, and protocol errors over the last 5 minutes. Prometheus increase may return fractional values due to extrapolation.

panels.title: Meta State and Directive Results (5 min)
panels.description: Complete desired-state applications and Data-side directive outcomes by node over the last 5 minutes.
